features.title: SRE basic catalog (public-facing, no price, no CTA)
features.summary: Public-facing catalog extension of website_sale for SRE Commercial, built inside mechanic_workshop. Inherits website_sale.products_item (tile in /shop list + search results) and website_sale.product (detail page). Shows: name, image (if any), Brand (OCA product_brand), Manufacturer (public name only, never the brand's partner_id), MPN, SKU, public categories, demo description (clearly labeled illustrative-only). HIDES: list_price, base unit price, Add to Cart, Add to RFQ, supplier / cost / source information, product.brand.partner_id. No new models, no new fields. Demo data: 2 brands + 2 manufacturers + 3 website categories + 6 products (3 valves + 3 pumps) + 6 variants, all sre_demo.* External IDs. Privacy: 0 brands with partner_id, 0 demo products with standard_price>0.

per_product: description (HTML — demo description rendered as spec sheet placeholder with illustrative-only banner)
no_data_inputs_for: RFQ flow (out of scope for this feature)

features.layout_decisions: Layout is in code, content via backend. No template-time toggle for the demo description. Adding a new product requires backend form; the tile and detail page pick up fields automatically.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1 /shop lists the 6 demo products as tiles; each tile shows name, image (placeholder if no image), Brand, MPN, SKU, link to detail. No price, no Add to Cart, no Add to RFQ.
AC-2 /shop?search=DMV-001 returns Demo Valve 001 as a tile with the same fields as AC-1.
AC-3 /shop?search=DemoBrand returns all 6 demo products as tiles (via description or name match).

AC-4 /shop/sre-demo-v-001-demo-valve-001-demo-56 (and the other 5 detail URLs) returns 200 and shows: name, image, identification table (Brand, Manufacturer, MPN, SKU, Categories), demo description with illustrative-only banner. No price block, no Add to Cart / Add to RFQ, no supplier / cost / source information.
AC-5 /shop/category/valves-demo-17 returns the 3 demo valves; /shop/category/pumps-demo-18 returns the 3 demo pumps. Tiles use the same shape as AC-1.
AC-6 HTTP 200 served to anonymous (guest) user; no redirect to /web/login required.
AC-7 Search HTML contains 0 product price patterns (no class product_price, no t-out price_reduce rendered for a product tile, no monetary widget rendered inside a product card).
AC-8 Detail HTML contains 0 supplier / cost / source data (no res.partner.city/email/phone, no standard_price, no supplierinfo, no attachments from a vendor).
AC-9 Mobile viewport (375px) renders the same fields without horizontal scroll. (Verified by Firefox headless screenshot inspection.)
AC-10 product.brand.partner_id remains NULL on all 2 demo brands (Risk #19).
AC-11 product.template.standard_price stays 0 on all 6 demo products (no cost leak).
AC-12 No traceback or critical log entry appears in `docker compose -p odoo_mechanic logs --tail=200 odoo` after all pages have been requested.
AC-13 `./scripts/agent_check.sh` exits 0 after the feature is shipped.
out_of_scope_for_this_feature: Multi-field search controller (sre_commercial_search from Sprint 1 plan) — current /shop?search= uses native website_sale search over name+description; the demo data ensures MPN/Brand are matched via description HTML. Real search is a separate feature.
RFQ flow (Sprint 1 sre_commercial_rfq). UI does not show an Add to RFQ button until that flow ships.
Theme overhaul (industrial palette) — current visual inherits the active Odoo website theme; this is a follow-up.
Mobile menu, homepage hero, navigation pillars — those are part of sre_commercial_website (Sprint 1).
